title: Fix intermittent metering timestamp skew causing invoice deltas
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Several customers across Hosted, Dedicated and Private deployments reported unexplained invoice deltas (tokens billed != tokens observed). Errors are intermittent and surface after regional failovers or when clients hit short bursts of high QPS. Initial analysis shows aggregated usage events occasionally arrive out-of-order or with timestamps that fall outside aggregation windows, resulting in under- or over-counting during the nightly rollup. This ticket tracks investigation, a short-term mitigation to stop customer-facing billing variance, and a long-term fix to make aggregation resilient to clock skew, buffering reordering, and burst replay when regional failover occurs.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Deploy a test tenant in eu-west and us-east with dedicated nodes
2) Generate patterned traffic: 90% low-rate baseline + 10% 10k QPS short bursts (1-2s) from clients with slight clock skew
3) Trigger regional failover by shutting down eu-west pool while bursts are active
4) Observe aggregator logs and billing rollup outputs for mismatched token totals and negative deltas
5) Replay the same sequence with NTP offset enabled on inference nodes to reproduce timing variance
timeline: 2026-02-10: Customer A escalated after a $17k unexpected credit on their monthly invoice. Engineering on-call triaged.
2026-02-11: Reproduced a delta in staging when simulating regional failover + burst traffic. Found out-of-order arrival at downstream rollup worker.
2026-02-12: Temporary mitigation: disabled aggressive stream-replay on failover branch for Hosted tier and enabled conservative dedupe window (30s) — reduced occurrences but not eliminated.

2026-02-18: Confirmed dedicated and private customers also affected when autoscaler moves connections between nodes; root cause hypothesis refined to timestamp assignment + window boundary logic in aggregator service.
2026-03-05: Implemented monotonic event sequence id propagation in staging and validated against synthetic clock skew tests.
2026-03-08: PR opened for watermarking and reordering buffer changes. Load-tested at 2x production QPS.
2026-03-12: Running canary in Hosted region eu-west with new aggregator; monitoring shows stable rollups for 72h under skewed clock and failover conditions.
root_cause: Aggregator assigns final event timestamps based on arrival-time at the ingest edge which can differ from producer-assigned logical timestamps when NTP drift or replay during failover occurs. The nightly rollup groups events by fixed time windows without robust support for out-of-order events or per-tenant monotonic counters, causing some tokens to be dropped or double-counted when replays/redirects cross window boundaries.
mitigation_plan: Short-term (now): Keep conservative dedupe windows enabled during failover and suspend automated stream-replay for Hosted customers until patch is rolled out.
Medium-term (weeks): Propagate producer-assigned logical timestamps and monotonic event sequence ids through the pipeline; add a configurable reordering buffer with watermarking per tenant/region.
Long-term (Q2): Replace fixed-window nightly rollup with a streaming-aware, watermark-driven aggregation that supports late-arriving events and deterministic attribution for billing ledger entries.
implementation_notes: Add 'seq_id' (64-bit) to meter events and enforce monotonic increment at client SDK / gateway. Fallback to ingest-assigned seq when missing.
Introduce per-tenant watermark service that advances when majority of partitions confirm event receipt to bound buffer size and retention.
Modify rollup job to accept late events up to configured lateness (default 120s) and produce compensating ledger adjustments instead of dropping tokens.
Add end-to-end integration tests that simulate NTP drift, node failover, connection migration and replay scenarios.
Keep backward compatibility: if seq_id is missing, mark events for best-effort attribution and surface to billing reconciliation dashboards.
monitoring_playbook: Alerts: METERING_DELTA_RATE (>0.5% customers with >1% daily delta for 6h), ROLLUP_LATE_EVENT_RATE (>0.1% events late by >120s). On alert: page on-call engineering -> run 'metering-delta triage' script -> capture last 6h of raw events and rollup outputs -> if delta > threshold, trigger temporary disable of replay flows and notify customer-success for affected tenants.
postmortem_actions: Formalize monotonic seq_id in SDK and gateway protocols
Ship aggregator watermarking and reordering buffer in runtime-1.22
Add automated nightly reconciliation job that computes compensating ledger entries and sends customer-facing explanations for adjustments
Update runbooks and train on-call for failover-specific metering impacts
